edges.fact: American Home Shield (AHS) offers the ShieldSilver plan, covering major home systems like plumbing, electrical, and HVAC, priced at $299-$399 per year.
American Home Shield (AHS) offers the ShieldGold plan, adding appliance coverage (refrigerators, ovens, dishwashers) on top of ShieldSilver, priced at $399-$499 per year.
American Home Shield (AHS) offers the ShieldPlatinum plan, its most comprehensive plan, priced at $499-$599 per year.
The ShieldGold plan builds upon the ShieldSilver plan, adding coverage for appliances like refrigerators, ovens, and dishwashers.
The ShieldPlatinum plan covers all items included in the ShieldGold plan, plus additional items like garbage disposals and ceiling fans.
